eps.d: Colt attempts to bring a corrupt Arizona sheriff back to California to face manslaughter charges.
Colt pursues a bail jumper to Mexico.
Colt is stymied by an embezzler who has the funds to make capture difficult.
Colt and Howie go undercover in a prison to prove a man was wrongfully convicted of robbery.
Colt tries to bring in a motorcycle-gang leader who's hiding in the desert.
Colt tracks an arsonist to a town run by the torch's mother.
A samurai mob chieftain is looking for the two bail jumpers who are breaking in on his marijuana trade.
Colt helps a con man get out of Las Vegas before he's hit by the mob.
An armed-robbery suspect is actually out to stop an assassination.
With Ryker out of action, Colt and Howie must stop the assassination.
A stuntman is nearly killed when a "gag" fails, and Colt suspects foul play.

eps.t: The Adventures of Ozzie and Harold
eps.d: A derelict witnesses a murder.
Colt infiltrates a survivalist camp to capture a mercenary wanted for gunrunning.
A woman claims she wants to find her brother before loan sharks do.
The manager of a wrestling team is threatened with death unless his wrestlers throw a match.
Colt protects the wife of a corrupt state official who wants her dead before she can release evidence that will ruin him.
Colt pursues a check forger who's being held prisoner in a town with a deadly secret.
Colt hooks up with a streetwise girl to protect her father, who's turning state's evidence against the mob.
Colt aids a colleague who helped a con man swindle $1 million from a mobster's son.
Colt pursues a beautiful bail jumper and stolen jewels.
Colt pursues a bail jumper who confessed to a killing committed by a music star.
An ex-naval officer eludes his partners in crime and tries to recover $5 million he stole from the Navy.
Colt doubles as a stunt double in a spy film and as a decoy for the Rio de Janeiro police, who want to nab a casino owner.
Colt and Howie jet to the tropics for a burglar (Ann Turkel), who turns out to have an identical twin.
Colt poses as a gang leader to take on corrupt county officials who framed a fellow stuntman for murder.
After Colt, Mary and Wild Dan escape, Littlefield arranges for the Outlaws---including Jody and Howie---to be arrested.
When Colt and Howie arrive at a carnival looking for an animal trainer, they find him dead---and the prime suspect is an orangutan.
Colt fails to make his train trip with a bail jumper as quiet as possible for the passenger in the next compartment---Richard Burton.
Colt ruins a police operation when he has a gambling den raided to flush out a bail jumper.
Jody joins the roller games to capture a skater who's wanted for assault and battery---and who's transporting drugs for her coach.

eps.t: How Do I Kill Thee... Let Me Count the Ways
eps.d: Colt teams with two gumshoes (Paul Williams, Pat McCormick) to keep tabs on a man facing trial for manslaughter---who looks ready to leave the country.
Colt's nephew and two pro-football teammates are shanghaied by an Army sergeant who wants a winning team for his base.
A posse of cowboys rides to Colt's aid when he becomes involved with car thieves while working as Roy Rogers' double.
Colt goes after con men running a scam on pre-Columbian treasures.

eps.t: The Further Adventures of Ozzie and Harold
eps.d: Ozzie and his imaginary friend Harold are back as witnesses to a murder---committed by someone from Harold's past.
Colt and his friendly nemesis (Judith Chapman) board a cruise ship to scuttle a jewel thief whose identity has been masked by plastic surgery.
Colt tries to protect a champion pool player (Tony Curtis) from mobsters who have bet against him.
A bank robbery, the kidnapping of Jody and a blackout are apparently the work of an extraterrestrial.
Jody is kidnapped to force Terri to post bail for a woman who stole $1 million.
Colt and Howie fly to Panama in pursuit of a man who jumped bail using a plane that's invisible to radar.

Colt makes a trip to rural South Carolina to help out his former sweetheart Irene after her husband has been murdered and her son made a fugitive by a wealthy and crooked businessman who uses the local moonshining operation as a cover for cocaine smuggling.
Colt aids Tab Hunter when the actor is framed for the murder of a gangland debt collector.
Colt tracks a master of disguise in New York after a $240,000 heist.
Cleavon Little plays a bail jumper who witnessed a murder by a paramilitary organization.

eps.t: Just a Small Circle of Friends
eps.d: A wealthy industrialist wants Colt to free his daughter from a cult before she signs away her inheritance.
Colt musters a small army of stuntmen to spring his high-school sweetheart from an island prison.
Howie's in critical condition after crashing, and Colt doesn't believe it was an accident.
Colt and Howie pursue a bail jumper being held on a tropical isle because she holds the key to stolen millions.
Army counterintelligence drafts Colt to get the goods on mercenaries planning a covert operation.
Colt poses as a getaway driver in a Government operation to nail a crime ring's "Mr. Big".
Colt protects a fight manager from mob entanglements while his boxer trains for a title bout.
An unscrupulous lawyer is forcing an entertainer to smuggle laundered money out of the country.
Terri is kidnapped to prevent Colt from testifying against a mobster.
Colt heads to Nashville to find a friend's son, who's mixed up in murder and record pirating.
A drug dealer needs a very small person to retrieve a lost package---and Colt's friend fits the bill.
Somebody doesn't want Colt and his partner to enter their car in a race---and will do anything to stop them.
A stuntman Colt once trained is now in a wheelchair---and wanted by the mob.
Howie and Jody must rescue Colt from a prison camp before a crooked sheriff kills him.
Colt looks for a hit lady with a fondness for art.
Colt masterminds a sting operation to trap a politician extorting money from a director.
Colt and Howie become fugitives in Argentina when they're involved in the jailbreak of the con man they were sent to bring back.
Attempts are made to kill Colt's sister after she films a kidnapping while in training for the Olympics.
In Hong Kong, Colt helps an American who wants to return three stolen Ming vases to the Chinese government.
Roy Rogers and a posse of TV cowboys team with Colt to round up horse rustlers involved in diamond smuggling.
Colt must raise a million-dollar ransom to save Jody from men threatening to blow up a hospital with her in it.
Colt races criminals and a shifty investigator (Mary Crosby) to recover $8 million in gold from a sunken boat near Bermuda.
Colt goes to bat for an ex-baseball player who's now a minor-league swindler with a heavy gambling debt.
Colt, a greedy insurance investigator, and a couple of thugs are all chasing a woman implicated in the theft of $3 million.
A novelist is pursued by a syndicate boss who wants the incriminating tape recording that's in her possession.
Jody is jailed for disturbing the peace by a county sheriff who sells female prisoners into prostitution.
Colt hides from hit men at a fraternity house while waiting for agents to pick up his prisoner.
Former TV crime-stoppers William Conrad, Mike Connors and Barry Newman give Colt more help than he needs to find out why someone's stealing his stunt cars.
During the filming of a movie at a mansion, the "ghost" of the owner (John Carradine) tries to scare everyone out of the house. Carradine's sons David, Keith and Robert have cameos.
Jody releases a bail jumper she's fallen for because he says he can prove he's not a murderer.
Colt is pursued over rugged terrain by a deputy sheriff who framed him and now wants him dead.
A teen infatuated with Colt stows away in his truck, impeding his efforts to find a diamond thief.
Colt's tricked into running an off-road race by a director, who bets on a Colt victory. But the bookie who took the bet plans to prevent Colt from finishing.
Jason Kingsley, a 10-year-old with Down syndrome, portrays a boy who runs away to compete in the Special Olympics---and winds up witnessing a murder.
Colt protects a bail-jumping trucker from extortionists who want to run her out of business.
To nail a bail jumper planning to murder a woman, Colt finagles a job as the woman's bodyguard.
Colt is tricked into going to Paris to identify a terrorist who's plotting to assassinate a Nobel Peace Prize winner.
Colt, acting as sheriff of a town, has 48 hours to bring in a bail jumper whose father owns the town.
Colt joins a flying circus to find a bank robber who saw his loot unearthed by the air show's owner.
Colt wants to change a stunt, unaware that it's being used to cover the theft of a microchip from the space shuttle.
A singer has evidence implicating an extortionist in the murder of a music producer.
During spring break, Colt protects a computer hacker from thugs who want an incriminating computer disc in his possession.
A shoe salesman is set up to take the fall by a mobster lookalike, who's wanted by both Colt and the dope dealer he double-crossed.
Colt and a family of con artists run a scam to flush out a crime boss whose features were altered through surgery.
An insurance representative asks Colt to track down the drug dealers who stole the negative of a movie he was working on.
An ex-con is being blackmailed into forging a new will for a man's "sickly" uncle.
Colt's former friend, now a rival, is his chief competition in a King of the Stuntmen contest.
Howie goes undercover as a female impersonator to protect a witness who's hiding from a killer.
Colt runs interference for Italian villagers who want his protection from gangsters while the villagers search for church relics hidden by the Nazis during WWII.
Colt's efforts to help a bail jumper find his daughter are thwarted when the man they suspect of kidnapping her is released for lack of evidence.
Colt and a movie-company crew are trapped at an English estate that is being stalked by an escapee from a home for the criminally insane.
Colt jumps bail after being framed for heroin possession---and to make matters worse, a bounty-hunting rival is on his trail.
A bail jumper working at a financially troubled orphanage---who believes he's Santa Claus---finds a locker containing $2 million worth of stolen bonds.
Colt is stranded on a deserted island with a snobby socialite who's being chased by thugs.
A rogue Federal agent traps Colt into helping him set up the biggest cocaine supplier on the East Coast.
Colt's classmate arranges to have a jewel shipment stolen to collect the insurance, but the plan backfires and his cohorts get greedy.
In Bangkok, Colt is approached by a man he knew in Vietnam who wants to go after a buddy who was recently seen in a Cambodian prison camp.
Colt meets the son he never knew he had, who's now in danger of falling in with car thieves.
A loser who arranged to have himself killed so his wife could collect insurance can't buy out of the contract after winning a lottery.
Colt enlists the aid of a rock band to capture an industrial spy.
Colt becomes a drill instructor when an Army buddy drafts him to help conduct an investigation of stolen equipment.

Pearl presses Colt to grab a conman at his wedding in San Diego and when he slips away under chaos, Colt is led to a trail of several women who have been tricked by the conman into marrying him and also has to get the better of the conman's other foes.

After the first bounty-hunter who was sent to nab a suspect seems to be procrastinating, bail bondsman Trench sends Colt to San Francisco to track them both and Colt soon gets drawn into a crooked deal involving a stash of stolen armor and mob money that the first bounty-hunter covets.

With Colt in hospital for a knee surgery, Howie and Jody reluctantly team up with an ex-actor and his pal, who used to play a crime-fighting duo in their movies, in probing a murder that the actor witnessed at a museum, and a recuperating Colt soon joins in.
Colt wins the contracts of two pro wrestlers in a poker game, and uses them when he goes after a counterfeiter who's also protected by heavyweights.
Bikers trap Colt, Howie and Jody in a deserted town soon to be turned into a reservoir and demand the release of their compadre.
A cop asks Colt to help him get evidence on a nightclub owner who's suspected of dealing PCP to kids.
